description: A script for cleaning up project directories by removing specified target folders and files, with options for dry run, verbose output, and user confirmation.

methods.name: resolveTargets
methods.description: Resolves target folder paths relative to the project root.

methods.name: pathExists
methods.description: Checks if a given path exists.

methods.name: execPromise
methods.description: Executes a shell command and returns a promise with stdout and stderr.

methods.name: removeWithNode
methods.description: Removes a directory or file using Node.js fs API, with fallback options.

methods.name: removePath
methods.description: Removes a specified path, with verbose logging and fallback to shell command.

methods.name: confirmPrompt
methods.description: Prompts the user for confirmation unless auto-confirmed with flags.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Main function that orchestrates the cleanup process, including user prompts and removal of target directories.
